concerns.text: FR-017 adds a formal a‑priori power analysis (≥90 % power to detect a 0.05 K/s RMSE reduction) which was not mentioned in the original idea. This introduces methodological scope beyond the stated research question.

FR-018 requires Bonferroni correction for multiple classification thresholds, a statistical procedure not present in the idea. It expands the scope into multiple‑testing correction that was not requested.

FR-008 imposes a stratified sampling constraint on element‑family representation (≤ [deferred] of any family, ±5 % tolerance). The idea never specified such a distribution constraint, so this adds extra scope.
